Introduction
This 
 document describes the regular maintenance that has to be done for done for HRSG 
 P.T.(pressure transmitter) and the interval of each item of 
 maintenance
The first draft is initiated by eng. Hany elokda, tested by eng. Bahaa abd 
 elwahab, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, accepted by 
 eng. Mohamed el sherif, general manager & eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPCo. 
 quality control general director, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawwan head sector of 
 Nubaria PS and certified by eng. Mohammed Nageb inspection and quality head 
 sector

Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued
Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, 
 Helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses)
Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified.
Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety rope 
 around the work place.
Tools 
and Equipment
Hart device
AVO meter
Blower, brushes
Cleaning fluids such as Freon - TF chlorothene
Work to be 
carried out
Inspection and 
maintenance of P.T.
Make calibration procedures to The pressure transmitters
Check the supply voltage (24 v dc)
Check the output (4-20 m AMP)
Transmitter cleaning
Close the work permit
